title: DOT/FAA Transportation Data Record
description: Schema for U.S. Department of Transportation / Federal Aviation Administration data covering flight operations, safety incidents, traffic statistics, and infrastructure records. Fields align with BTS On-Time Performance, FAA Incident, and T-100 traffic datasets for seamless integration in POC demonstrations.

record_id.description: Unique identifier for the record (UUID v4)

flight_number.description: Flight number assigned by the carrier (e.g. 1234)

origin_airport.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the origin

destination_airport.description: Three-letter IATA airport code for the destination

departure_date.description: Scheduled departure date in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD)

scheduled_departure.description: Scheduled departure time in HH:MM (24-hour) format

actual_departure.description: Actual departure time in HH:MM (24-hour) format

delay_minutes.description: Total departure delay in minutes; 0 or negative indicates on-time or early departure

delay_cause.description: Primary cause of delay as classified by BTS

diverted.description: Whether the flight was diverted to an alternate airport

passengers.description: Number of passengers on board or transported

incident_severity.description: Severity classification of the safety incident

airport_category.description: Airport hub classification per FAA NPIAS

visibility_miles.description: Prevailing visibility in statute miles at the time of operation

wind_speed_knots.description: Surface wind speed in knots at the time of operation

load_time.description: Timestamp when the record was loaded into the Fabric lakehouse

_ingested_at.description: Timestamp when the record was ingested into the Fabric lakehouse

_source.description: Source system identifier, e.g. bts_ontime_api or faa_incident_api

_batch_id.description: Batch run identifier for lineage and reprocessing traceability
